title: 纸境换位

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮登记：人物居中倒悬于左上相连折纸树，纸峡与水面正反空间可辨，水中有对应倒影。未做审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot master for The Hanged Man, theme 纸境换位 / Paper-Realm Reversal. Use the original solely for character identity: exactly ONE peaceful dark-haired person hangs HEAD DOWN at center, one ankle clearly tied to a PHYSICAL folded-paper tree branch extending from the UPPER LEFT, other leg bent. The origami tree must show complete connected folds from branch through trunk to a broad base. Invent layered paper mountains and a paper canyon forming an upright/reversed spatial frame, with a still paper-edged water surface below showing one aligned reflection. Palette warm paper white, ink green, restrained vermilion, natural human skin; visible paper fiber and painted folds. Figure remains real and painterly, not a paper doll, with coherent limbs, calm expression and visible rope knot. Fine narrow gold tarot frame. No second person, no detached support, no lettering or pseudo-text, title, numbers, watermark or logo. Complete opaque 2:3 illustration for later layering.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、脚绳、连接枝整体；倒影与水面一组，需要随观察正确对应，否则关闭主体额外视差；本主题支撑归属：折纸树完整折面连接，水面与倒影固定. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
